# <a id="ph-pd"></a>Phase 4: P&D · Production and Deployment

Produce and field the system; operational test and evaluation confirms security in the intended environment, and the system operates only under a current authorization. The Monitor step starts with the first fielded units.

| | |
|---|---|
| Starts at | [MS C](PH-EMD.md#ms-c) Milestone C |
| Ends at | [FRP/FD](#ms-frp) Full-Rate Production or Full Deployment Decision |
| RMF steps active | [R Authorize](../../MANUAL.md#step-r), [M Monitor](../../MANUAL.md#step-m) |
| Tasks | 0 with this primary phase; 11 more also run here |
| Authorization decisions possible | [ATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-ato), [ATO w/ conditions](../../MANUAL.md#ad-atoc), [DATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-dato), [cATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-cato), [ATU](../../MANUAL.md#ad-atu), [DATU](../../MANUAL.md#ad-datu), [CCA](../../MANUAL.md#ad-cca), [DCCA](../../MANUAL.md#ad-dcca), [Continue](../../MANUAL.md#ad-cont), [cATO revoked](../../MANUAL.md#ad-rcato), [Rescinded](../../MANUAL.md#ad-resc) |

**Entry criteria**

- Milestone C approved with a valid authorization for the systems being fielded.

**Exit criteria**

- Full-rate production or full deployment decision made; initial operational capability reached under a current ATO.
- Operational cybersecurity assessments (CVPA and adversarial assessment) completed, and the mission-critical vulnerabilities they found eliminated before fielding.
- Continuous monitoring (M-1 to M-5) is running for the fielded configuration.

**Sources**

- [DODI8510.01](../../MANUAL.md#ref-dodi8510-01), p. 10, "Operate only authorized DoD systems with a current authorization to operate"
- [DODI5000.85](../../MANUAL.md#ref-dodi5000-85), p. 17, "3.13. P&D PHASE."
- [DODI5000.89](../../MANUAL.md#ref-dodi5000-89), p. 16, "cooperative vulnerability and penetration assessment (CVPA) and an adversarial assessment"
- [DODI5000.89](../../MANUAL.md#ref-dodi5000-89), p. 17, "each of which should then be eliminated before fielding the system"
- [DODI5000.85](../../MANUAL.md#ref-dodi5000-85), p. 17, "informed by consideration of any new validated threat environments"
